experiment: per-DAC-bit phasor audit of mask-04 PROM tone and carrier

fixture.input: held D127 tone 88 or unmodulated carrier B0
fixture.latch: candidate U10 D2 edge divided by 375

limitations: Every Y-to-latch bit, DAC clock and analog output route remains a hypothesis except the photo-suggested Q4-to-B5 segment.
Per-bit phasors show where the assumed digital carrier is encoded; they do not measure DAC current or line output.
Held D127 words are controller-mode hypotheses, not live controller/DSC co-simulation.
